pr_body:
This project can take trade as well as orderbook information from Kaiko
and convert the data into Lean compatible data at all resolutions in
modeled as both trades and quotes.

Fixes #1260

issue_context.title: Sample BTC data with no volume
issue_context.body: The code expects trading volume information but the sample BTC data at Data\crypto\gdax\daily\btcusd.zip lacks it.
comments: Hi @manisin - There have been a couple recent PR's updating the crypto data format. I'll try to get the sample data in place soon
